वट् {vI.v} {c1c} P. (वटति) To surround.
{vII.v} {c10c} U. (वटयति-ते)
1 To tell.
--2
To divide, partition.
--3 To
surround, encompass.
--4 To tie, string,
connect. --Caus. (वटयति) To speak.

वाट् An exclamation uttered on
making an oblation of butter &c.

वटः [वट्-अच्]
1 The fig-tree; अयं
च चित्रकूटयायिनि वर्त्मनि वटः, श्यामो
नाम

.
--2 A small shell
or cowrie.
--3 A small ball, globule,
pill.
--4 A round figure, a cipher.
--5 A kind of cake.
--6 A string,
rope (n. also in this sense).
--7
Equality in shape.
--Comp.
--पत्रं
a variety of the white basil.
--(त्रा)
a jasmine.
--वासिन् m. a Yakṣa.

enclosure, a piece of enclosed ground,
court; स्ववाटकुक्कुटविजयहृष्टः Dk.; so
वेश˚, श्मशान˚ &c.
--2 A garden, park,
an orchard.
--3 A road.
--4 The
groin.
--5 A sort of grain
--Comp.

--2 A

वटर a.
1 Wicked, villainous.
--रः
A cock.
--2 A mat.
--3 A turban.
--4

--5 A
churningstick.
--6 Fragrant grass.
वटाकरः, वटारकः A cord, string.
वटाकरः, वटारकः A cord, string.

1 A pill.
--2 A chessman.
--3 A kind of cake or bread (Mar.

1 The site of a house.
--2

पुष्प˚, अशोक˚ &c.
